# Roadmap and delivery ladder

Weeks assume one full-time developer with AI coding help, using the screens already designed. Phases overlap on purpose: the next phase starts while the previous release is in pilot. Dates are planning targets, not promises. Regulator onboarding and hospital procurement are outside our control.

> **Calendar assumption:** Week 1 starts **Monday 26 Oct 2026** (the first Monday after PRD v2, dated 20 Oct 2026). To move the plan, change `WEEK1` in `tools/prd-extract/render_docs.py` and `tools/tickets/build.py`, then regenerate.

| Phase | Name | Weeks | Start | End | Release | Delivered to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | Foundation and safety | Weeks 1–3 | 26 Oct 2026 | 13 Nov 2026 | R0 · Internal platform | Founder and clinical advisor (staging, synthetic data only) |
| P1 | Front desk and appointments MVP | Weeks 4–10 | 16 Nov 2026 | 01 Jan 2027 | R1 · Front Desk | Receptionists, doctors (schedule view) and owners at 2 design-partner clinics |
| P2 | Doctor workspace and EMR core | Weeks 9–15 | 21 Dec 2026 | 05 Feb 2027 | R2 · Consult | Doctors and nurses at the 2 partner clinics |
| P3 | AI-drafted notes under clinician review | Weeks 13–20 | 18 Jan 2027 | 12 Mar 2027 | R3 · Scribe | 5–10 opt-in clinicians under clinical review |
| P4 | Billing, care follow-up and patient portal | Weeks 17–26 | 15 Feb 2027 | 23 Apr 2027 | R4 · Clinic Ops | Clinic owners and admins, care coordinators and the clinics’ patients |
| P5 | Commercial launch v1.0 | Weeks 24–32 | 05 Apr 2027 | 04 Jun 2027 | R5 · v1.0 GA | First paying clinic (week 29), then the first 5 paying clinics in the launch market |
| P6 | Wearable capture and advanced AI | Weeks 33–42 (after hardware is stable) | 07 Jun 2027 | 13 Aug 2027 | R6 · Clip | Doctors issued a Medvya clip, and their practice admins |
| P7 | Hospital enterprise and integrations | Weeks 36–60 | 28 Jun 2027 | 17 Dec 2027 | R7 · Enterprise | First hospital customer: IT, administrators and clinicians |
| P8 | Scale and specialty features | Week 52 onward | 18 Oct 2027 | 14 Jan 2028 | R8 · Ongoing | All customers, by demand |

## What each recipient can do on day one

| Phase | Release | Day one |
|---|---|---|
| P0 | R0 · Internal platform | Sign in with MFA, invite a colleague, see role-based navigation and walk the six end-to-end journeys on staging. |
| P1 | R1 · Front Desk | Register patients, book, reschedule and cancel appointments, check patients in, run the waiting room and send automatic confirmations and reminders. |
| P2 | R2 · Consult | Open Doctor Today, see the patient chart, record vitals, write and sign a note, and print a prescription, without AI. |
| P3 | R3 · Scribe | Record a consented consultation on phone or desktop, review a draft note with evidence links, correct it and sign. |
| P4 | R4 · Clinic Ops | Bill and collect payment, close the cash drawer, track every result and follow-up to closure, and let patients book and see their records. |
| P5 | R5 · v1.0 GA | Switch from the old system without closing, with history migrated, insurance checked at the desk and a paid subscription. |
| P6 | R6 · Clip | Pair a clip, record without a phone on the desk, get mixed-language notes and a private earpiece assistant. |
| P7 | R7 · Enterprise | Connect Medvya to the hospital HIS, sign in with hospital SSO, and write signed notes back with conflicts surfaced. |
| P8 | R8 · Ongoing | Features released individually as minor versions. |

## Calendar risks spotted while dating the plan

- **P1 (16 Nov 2026 – 01 Jan 2027) runs through the year-end holidays.** The exit criterion "2 consecutive weeks of real bookings" may slip if partner clinics run reduced hours. Plan the pilot weeks for early January if needed.
- **P2 and P3 overlap P1/P2 pilots** (weeks 9–10 and 13–15). With one developer, overlap is only safe while the previous phase is in pilot (bug-fix mode), as PRD v2 intends.
- **P7 (weeks 36–60) depends on hospital procurement**, so its dates are the least certain.
